value.rationale: The exact landscape of the Gelfand two-plane restriction objective is a natural unknown invariant beyond an already-known width; it classifies all nearly minimizing planes and measures their exact Grassmannian distance. The finite-target quadratic to infinite-target linear transition is a structural, sharp stability distinction relevant to near-optimal Schatten embedding subspaces.
